rules.description: For post‑matric and Merit‑cum‑Means based scholarships, the bank account must be held solely in the student's name.
rules.condition: When the scholarship is post‑matric or Merit‑cum‑Means based.
rules.outcome: The account must be exclusive to the student (no joint ownership).
rules.evidence_quote: post-matric and Merit-cum-Means based scholarships. In his/her name

rules.description: For pre‑matric scholarships, the bank account may be either exclusive to the student or a joint account with any parent.
rules.outcome: The account can be exclusive or joint with a parent.
rules.evidence_quote: In his/her name either exclusive or joint account with any of his/her parent in case of pre-matric scholarships.
